feature: Redesigned the viewer as an immersive full-bleed screen: the image now fills the whole window under the status and navigation bars, and the top and bottom bars are translucent overlays that hide or return with a single tap
Overlay title bar with the file name, a `3 / 12` style page counter while browsing a folder or a selection, and a top-right menu hosting `Reset zoom` and `Print / Save PDF`
Bottom action bar with icon buttons for `Details`, `Rotate`, `Share`, and `Open with`, plus a floating pause / resume button that appears only for animated GIFs
Image details now open in a draggable bottom sheet with the file name, MIME type, size, resolution, decoded color information, and EXIF fields; swipe down, tap the image, or press back to close it
improvement: Edge-to-edge system bar and display cutout handling, so the layout stays fully visible on Android 15 and later instead of being covered by system bars
Every icon control carries an accessibility description matching its former text label
Build verification rejects accidental native dependencies and produces a JSON report

hint: AutoJs6 host build 5276 or later is required for explorer-action v12 same-folder browsing and explicit multi-selection
feature: Browse supported images in the same folder by swiping in natural filename order, or open an explicit selection of up to 128 images while preserving the host selection order
Enhanced viewer gestures with focal pinch zoom, 2.5x double-tap zoom, 90-degree view rotation, a transient zoom indicator and pause/resume controls for animated GIFs

On-demand EXIF details with automatic correction of all 8 orientation variants and hidden GPS coordinates, plus decoded pixel depth and color space when available and printing or saving the full image as PDF
HEIC / HEIF support on Android 9 or later and AVIF support on Android 12 or later, backed by real decoder capability probes and clear unsupported-format messages
Tiled viewing for huge JPEG / PNG and static HEIC / HEIF images, using a bounded preview and high-resolution tiles for the visible region within a capped memory budget
improvement: Hardened every entry path with strict explorer-action v12 request, target, content, size and direct-child validation while retaining temporary read-only access and no storage or network permissions
Expanded the localized interface and user documentation in 10 languages, including a five-image gallery captured from the real Android UI
dependency: Added AndroidX ExifInterface 1.4.2 for read-only EXIF metadata parsing

fix: Enabling the plugin in the AutoJs6 plugin center failed because the service returned an empty binding (onNullBinding)
improvement: Leaner plugin name and description with consistent wording across all language documents

feature: First release of Image Viewer: a `View image` primary action for the AutoJs6 file manager, opening supported image files in a dedicated viewer with a single tap
Support for 8 extensions, BMP / GIF / JFIF / JPE / JPEG / JPG / PNG / WEBP, decoded by Android and Glide, with animated GIFs playing automatically
Viewer with fit-to-screen display, focal pinch zoom up to 5x, one-finger panning, double-tap restore, and tap-to-hide controls
File name in the title bar, MIME type, file size, and decoded resolution in the information bar, plus `Reset zoom`, `Share`, and `Open with another app` actions (excluding the plugin itself)

Isolated file manager and external `ACTION_VIEW` entries, both gated by temporary read-only content URI grants and item-by-item validation, with an 8 TiB per-file cap and no storage or network permissions
Plugin service registered on explorer-action protocol version 2, requiring host build 5269 or later
Plugin metadata, UI, instructions, and documents in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong / Taiwan), English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Arabic
dependency: Introduced Glide 5.0.5 as the image decoding and rendering engine
